steps.say: We find out about the world with our senses. We have five senses.
We see with our eyes. We hear with our ears.

figure.alt: An eye for sight and an ear for hearing.

steps.say: We smell with our nose. We taste with our tongue.

figure.alt: A nose for smell and a tongue for taste.

steps.say: We feel with our skin. Touch tells us if things are hot, cold, rough or smooth.
Senses keep us safe. A smoke alarm warns us with a loud sound.
Only taste food when an adult says it is safe.

check.prompt: Which sense do you use to smell a flower?

options.why: Sight tells you its colour. It does not tell you its smell.

hints: Think about breathing in near a flower.
Which body part do you use?
Point to your nose. Which sense goes with it?
check.explanation: We smell a flower with our nose. This sense is called smell.

hints: They are on the sides of your head.
Cover them with your hands. What gets quieter?
check.explanation: We hear with our ears. Sounds travel into our ears.
